svg.title: One map, five moments in the story
svg.desc: Vale's town gate is one map for the whole game, and each time the party arrives it asks the story which set of map events to use, testing in order. Has the party reached Kalay? Then the map events after Kalay. Has the party left Vale? Then the map events after leaving. Has the party come from the Sanctum? Then the farewell. Is it the stormy night? Then the storm. Otherwise, the map events of the day the story begins. Below, the same map on the day the story begins and on the stormy night, as the game draws them: Isaac grown, in the sun, and Isaac as a child, in the rain.
svg.text: VALE'S TOWN GATE: WHICH MAP EVENTS?
Otherwise: the day the story begins
The newest moment is tested first, so one
map can serve the whole game. Its warps and
people are chosen the same way.
